selection: Purposeful controls from a previously inspected 100-release live sample and its Helm/Maven coverage follow-ups. Selected to cover ordinary informational signals and distinct manifest formats. Review was not blind to scanner output; this is not an unseen test set or a prevalence sample.
groups: Keep both AWS SDK Kotlin components together and both fragcap crates together. Ten releases form eight conservative project groups; operator independence is unproven.
members: Selected archive manifests and READMEs, plus separate Maven POMs. Feed descriptions are omitted because they are package-level snapshots. Document source_kind distinguishes archive members from separately fetched manifests.
evaluation_status: All documents had been scanned before promotion. No expressions or weights were changed for this selection.
